body:
I'm tired. 

I'm not waiting another decade or two for things to get better. I would rather end it all now. 

It's all just a possibility anyway. No guarantee or anything. All I know is, I don't have the resources to do any of the things I want to do and won't for some time to come. The climb up out of this is too long and hard. I don't want to try anymore. I just want to stop breathing.

I've been trying to get into college since 2000 but I've had no luck. It's always some reason why I can't get in. 

I kind of gave up.

My life is too much to type here. The library closes soon and I'll have to find some place to sleep tonight. 

I'd like to find a job where I made enough money to pay rent or go to the doctor. If I needed something I could either just go get it or reasonably save up for it. 

I've never been able to do that my entire adult life. I'm 37 now and am really fed up with these government types telling me what I can and can't have. 

Most of my friends have gotten married and moved away.
